name: Strangely Marked Box
summary: Along Darkshore, a Strangely Marked Box is found among cargo on dead sea turtles. Its runes point to the naga and show that the turtles did not come ashore by chance.

sections.title: Trophies of the Deep
sections.body: Dead sea turtles and other sea creatures wash up on Darkshore's beaches. Some carry broken harnesses and carriages strapped to their shells. Sealed boxes marked with foreign, winding runes lie among the wreckage. Greymist murlocs often shelter in the hollow ribs and broken wagons, feeding on the carcasses and guarding what remains.

sections.title: Evidence of Naga Expansion
sections.body: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde, a researcher for the Temple of the Moon in Auberdine, recognizes the markings. The script and the carriages belong to the naga, who use giant turtles to carry supplies and war equipment onto land. The boxes show that naga are active along the northern shores and may be driving their mounts south toward Ashenvale. The priesthood in Auberdine sends the relics to Darnassus for study.

faq.q: Where is the Strangely Marked Box found?
aliases: where to find strangely marked box
faq.answer: The box is found in an abandoned carriage strapped to a dead sea turtle along Darkshore's coast. Greymist murlocs often feed near the carcasses and guard what remains.

faq.q: Who made the Strangely Marked Box?
faq.answer: The naga made the box and its inscriptions. They strap carriages to living sea turtles to carry provisions, arms, and equipment from the ocean depths onto Kalimdor's shores.

faq.q: Who wants this box in Auberdine?
aliases: who do i turn this in to
faq.answer: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde, a researcher for the Temple of the Moon in Auberdine, collects the box to study the strange beachings and the naga threat.

faq.q: Why were the sea turtles carrying these boxes?
faq.answer: The naga use giant sea turtles as beasts of burden, strapping harnesses and carriages to their backs to carry supplies and war equipment onto land. Gwennyth suspects one turtle was killed while heading south, perhaps toward Ashenvale.

faq.q: What happens to the box after giving it to Gwennyth?
faq.answer: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde sends the box and the coastal survey findings to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, where the night elf leadership can study the naga's reach.

angles.text: Finding naga supply boxes lashed to native sea turtles along Darkshore warns the kaldorei that their ancient, mutated kin are pushing ashore from the Great Sea.
As a priest, you help the Temple of the Moon's scholars in Auberdine secure shore relics as they work to protect the coast from marine corruption.
